source_record_subset.mysql: SELECT CAST( SUM( `t2`.`gender` = 'F' ) AS DOUBLE ) * 100 / COUNT( `t2`.`client_id` ) FROM `district` AS `t1` INNER JOIN `client` AS `t2` ON `t1`.`district_id` = `t2`.`district_id` WHERE `t1`.`a11` > 10000
source_record_subset.cracksql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN "t2"."gender" = 'F' THEN 1 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 100 / COUNT( t2.client_id ) FROM "district" AS "t1" INNER JOIN "client" AS "t2" ON "t1"."district_id" = "t2"."district_id" WHERE "t1"."a11" > 10000
